free.question: Is Eatrivo free?
free.answer: Yes! The basic version is completely free. You can create a profile, get personalized meal plans and shopping lists without any cost. The premium version offers advanced features for full utilization in achieving your goals, but the basic features are free for everyone.

time.question: How long does it take to get a meal plan?
time.answer: Filling in your profile takes about 2 minutes. After that, AI instantly generates your personalized plan.

cancel.question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
cancel.answer: Of course. No commitments, no hidden fees. You can cancel with one click via the Stripe portal.

vegan.question: Does it work for vegetarians and vegans?
vegan.answer: Yes! When setting up your profile, you choose your dietary preferences and Rivo takes them into account in every plan.

allergies.question: What if I have allergies or intolerances?
allergies.answer: In your profile, you set all allergies and foods you want to avoid. Plans automatically exclude them.
